description: Check a post against platform limits the way the platforms count: X/Twitter weighted length (links = 23, emoji = 2, CJK = 2; limit 280), Threads 500, Bluesky 300, Instagram 2,200 (+ 30 hashtags), LinkedIn 3,000, Facebook 63,206, TikTok 4,000, YouTube title 100 / description 5,000, Pinterest 500, Google title ~60, meta description ~160. Characters are counted as user-perceived graphemes (one emoji = 1). Also: words, hashtags, mentions, links, emoji, and SMS encoding (GSM-7 vs Unicode) with the number of SMS parts and the characters that force Unicode. Give "text" or a text file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/social-counter/

gsmLookalikes.description: Also return the text with curly quotes, dashes, ellipses, odd spaces etc. replaced by GSM-7 look-alikes (cheaper SMS).

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

platforms.description: Only these meters: x, threads, bsky, ig, li, fb, tt, yt, ytd, pin, gt (Google title), gd (meta description). Default: all.

name: text_social_count
title: Social media character counter
